description: Research r13 (dev only, H100): r10's recipe (A 002 with mean-centred advantages, adv_norm none) plus a KL penalty to the base model (kl_coef 0.05, k3 estimator per token). r10 seed 1 searched, peaked at 0.315 at step 300 and slid back to short outputs (0.180 at the end, LOG 2026-10-25 05:18); the base model writes long outputs, so the KL pull works against that slide and against the early one-guess collapse. KL needs skip_zero_advantage off. To fit the 3.4 GB reference model on the 80 GB H100, vLLM gets 0.30 of the GPU (r10: 0.35) and micro-batches hold 4,096 tokens (r10: 8,192); neither changes the gradient, only speed.
